# Seyyed Arad Hosseini Moghaddam

AI engineer and data scientist with documented projects in medical imaging, deep learning, NLP, language models, agentic AI and reproducible evaluation. Independently self-studying advanced neuroscience and exploring AI applications in brain genomics, neuroinformatics, neuroimaging and neuropharmacology. Ongoing quantitative humanities interests remain part of the portfolio. Public engineering projects are distinct from emerging neuroscience application directions; no undocumented experimental or clinical results, publications or institutional affiliations are claimed.

## Current neuroscience study and applications

- Brain genomics: gene variants, expression, neural pathways and computational omics.
- Neuroinformatics: neural data integration, quality checks, provenance and ML.
- Neuroimaging: brain MRI / functional neuroimaging methods, building on existing 3D cardiac MRI segmentation work.
- Neuropharmacology: neural drug mechanisms, psychopharmacology and computational psychiatry applications.
- Independent advanced neuroscience self-study: neural circuits, anatomy, molecular biology, and pharmacology.
- Status: active study and developing applications, not completed or clinically validated discoveries.

## Flagship work
- [Persian GPT — Transformer From Scratch case study](https://aradmanamnaoon.github.io/projects/persian-gpt-from-scratch/): Public from-scratch Persian language-model artifact. A pinned metadata-only check counted 134,994,432 stored tensor elements in the exported safetensors file; the model card states a 110.4M architecture. Runtime tying and the reported evaluation have not been independently reproduced. [source project](https://huggingface.co/aradmanamnaoon/persian-lm-from-scratch)
- [3D Cardiac MRI Segmentation case study](https://aradmanamnaoon.github.io/projects/3d-cardiac-mri-segmentation/): A research-oriented 3D left-atrium segmentation experiment using PyTorch, MONAI, and a two-class U-Net. It documents NIfTI loading, case-level splitting, mixed-precision training, sliding-window inference and an author-reported MSD Task02 Heart validation metric. [source project](https://github.com/aradmanamnaoon/medical-image-segmentation)
- [AI Research Assistant Platform case study](https://aradmanamnaoon.github.io/projects/multi-agent-ai-research-assistant/): A multi-agent research assistant built with LangGraph, ChromaDB RAG, FastAPI, and LangSmith. Planning, retrieval, parallel research, tool execution, citation-grounded synthesis, bounded reflection, persistent state, and streaming are covered in the public implementation. [source project](https://github.com/aradmanamnaoon/ai-research-assistant-platform)
- [ResearchWeave — Local-First Research Workbench case study](https://aradmanamnaoon.github.io/projects/researchweave/): A Rust/Slint desktop research workbench connecting literature and evidence, native PDF reading, dataset analysis, qualitative coding, manuscripts, provenance, and optional approval-gated AI. The published v0.3.0 early-access installers are not an independently certified stable release. [source project](https://github.com/aradmanamnaoon/researchweave)
- [Constellation — Local-First Multi-Agent AI Workspace case study](https://aradmanamnaoon.github.io/projects/constellation/): An experimental, publicly available Rust/Tauri 2/Svelte 5 desktop workspace for attributed AI-agent conversations, model-provider selection, small task workflows and explicit, reviewed local actions. Source code is public; unsigned v0.1.2 Windows and Linux preview packages are available, but there is no production-certified release. [source project](https://github.com/aradmanamnaoon/constellation)

## Areas of work
- Deep learning, machine learning, medical imaging, and 3D image segmentation.
- Statistics, exploratory analysis, and data science for humanities-related datasets.
- Python, SQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, MONAI, Hugging Face, Transformers, PEFT, LoRA, and QLoRA.
- NLP, Persian language modeling, machine translation, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, and MCP.
- FastAPI, Docker, MLflow, Git, GitHub Actions, web development, Django, PyQt6, and Flutter for Android and iOS.
